column1: # Where our paragraph numbers differ from the Urantia Foundation's (SRT v1.22),
# as build/foundation.py finds them in its HTML: our first, our last, its first,
# its last; "-" where it has no number.  The build requires exactly these runs.
# It does not number the ACKNOWLEDGMENT; the press does (study edition 8af25c5).
# It numbers the `* * *` separator in 134:6 as 134:6.14.
# It files the one heading over sections 9 and 10 under 10 (CLAUDE.md §7.9).
# It numbers each of the six separators between the prayers of 144:5.
